adaptive_em.policy: component edges > max(262144, ceil(all multi-EC edges/requested threads)); otherwise preserve component-local updates
adaptive_em.selection_inputs: Counted EC graph and requested thread count; no accession, tissue or read-count rules. The scalar single-thread and general bias kernels are unchanged.

adaptive_index_construction.policy: Use bounded collection, exact four-byte adaptive edge ranks, five-byte keys packed before topology, a prefix-owned 12-bit/key conservative three-bit rejection filter, exact sparse full-word reference-walk landmarks, and early scratch retirement for large graphs.
